ref.substituent_description: 9-Ethylcarbazole (Et on ring N) whose 3-position (right benzo ring carbon para to the N-bearing fusion carbon C9a) carries a CH2 to the N of a piperidine. Piperidine C4 is the spiro carbon of an indane; the indane C2 (next to spiro) bears OH on a solid wedge and C1 (next to the benzo ring) bears NHAc on a hashed bond.
ref.notes: Typeset. Three benzene rings each with 3 alternating double bonds (9 total). One solid wedge (OH), one hashed wedge (NHAc).

wrong.substituent_description: Carbazole (two circled benzo rings) with CH2CH3 on the ring N. The CH2 linker to the piperidine N is on the right benzo ring at the carbon two bonds from the N-bearing fusion carbon (carbazole 2-position, meta to C9a). Piperidine C4 is spiro to an indane; indane carbon next to spiro bears OH on a solid wedge, and the carbon next to the benzo ring bears NH-C(=O)-CH3 (written out, explicit C) on a hashed bond.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Small thickened ink mark at the aryl end of the bond from the benzo ring to the CH(NH) carbon; not a wedge.
Acetyl drawn out as NH-C(CH3)=O with explicit C.
wrong.notes: Handwritten, black ink. Only drawn double bond is the acetyl C=O.

correct.substituent_description: Carbazole (circled benzo rings) with Et on ring N; CH2 on the right benzo ring at the carbon para to the N-bearing fusion carbon (3-position) links to piperidine N. Piperidine C4 is spiro to an indane; carbon next to spiro bears OH on a solid wedge, carbon next to the benzo ring bears NHAc on a hashed bond.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: H of NHAc has a slightly odd crossbar but reads as NHAc
Small gap/dot on the left edge of the piperidine ring; ring is still 6-membered
correct.notes: Handwritten black ink. Aromatic rings drawn as circles, no explicit double bonds.

errors_in_wrong.description: Reference attaches the CH2-piperidine linker at carbazole C3 (right benzo ring carbon para to the N-bearing fusion carbon C9a); the wrong drawing attaches it at C2 (the ring carbon meta to C9a, two bonds from it along the top edge).
Reference N-substituent is the abbreviation 'Et'; the wrong drawing expands it to 'CH2CH3'.
Reference indane C1 substituent is the abbreviation 'NHAc'; the wrong drawing expands it to NH-C(=O)-CH3 with explicit C, CH3 and =O.

review_notes: Wrong drawing moves the CH2 linker from carbazole C3 to C2 and expands Et and NHAc. Corrected drawing restores C3, Et and NHAc with matching stereo; the H in NHAc is slightly odd but readable.
